citations.claim: light body leaves heavy-body head-on elastic collision at ~157 m/s, far above elastic-collision prediction (~59 m/s), showing excess impulse/positional energy injection
first violating step: total energy exceeds initial plus 10%+5J tolerance with zero controller work

counterfactual.change: changed only light body mass m 0.2 -> 20 (equal masses, one field); same dt/steps/gravity/geometry removes slingshot and no rule is violated

explanation: Head-on elastic collision with 100:1 mass ratio injects energy: light body rebounds at ~157 m/s instead of ~59 m/s expected from 1D elastic theory, raising total mechanical energy from ~5229 J to ~5769 J with zero controller work, exceeding 10%+5J bound. Likely cause is impulse plus positional (Baumgarte/slop) correction over-correcting deep overlap accumulated over substeps for very unequal masses, adding non-physical work each substep.
vision_note: The large and small circles approach and make contact at step 52, then separate. By step 54 the small circle is flung far to the right while the large circle remains nearly stationary, showing an excessively fast rebound.
